steps.title: Look around
steps.text: Move the camera with WASD, the arrow keys or the screen edges. Zoom with the mouse wheel.
steps.text_touch: Drag a finger to move the camera. Pinch with two fingers to zoom.

steps.title: Your villagers
steps.text: Villagers do all the work. Left click one to select it.
steps.text_touch: Villagers do all the work. Tap one to select it.

steps.title: Gather food
steps.text: With a villager selected, right click the berry bushes to gather food.
steps.text_touch: With a villager selected, tap the berry bushes to gather food.

steps.title: Gather wood
steps.text: Select another villager and right click a tree. Drag a box to select several at once.
steps.text_touch: Tap another villager, then tap a tree. To pick several, press Area and drag over them.

steps.title: More hands
steps.text: Villagers carry what they gather to the Town Center. Spend that food: click the Town Center and train a villager.
steps.text_touch: Villagers carry what they gather to the Town Center. Hold a finger on the Town Center to select it, then press the villager button.

steps.title: Build a house
steps.text: The top bar shows your population and its limit. Houses raise it. Select a villager, press the House button, then click the ground.
steps.text_touch: The top bar shows your population and its limit. Houses raise it. Tap a villager, press the House button, touch the ground and lift your finger where you want it.

steps.title: A bigger village
steps.text: Now there is room. Train villagers until you have six. Shift + click queues five at once.
steps.text_touch: Now there is room. Hold a finger on the Town Center and train villagers until you have six.

steps.title: Mine gold
steps.text: Soldiers cost gold. The Idle button (or the period key) finds villagers with nothing to do: send one to the gold mine.
steps.text_touch: Soldiers cost gold. The Idle button selects a villager with nothing to do: then tap the gold mine.

steps.title: Plant a farm
steps.text: Berries run out, farms keep feeding you. Select a villager and build a Farm next to the Town Center. The builder starts farming by itself.
steps.text_touch: Berries run out, farms keep feeding you. Tap a villager, press the Farm button and lift your finger next to the Town Center. The builder starts farming by itself.

steps.title: Explore
steps.text: The dark areas are unexplored. Select your scout and send it towards the arrow: bandits have camped nearby. You can also right click the minimap.
steps.text_touch: The dark areas are unexplored. Tap your scout, then tap the ground towards the arrow: bandits have camped nearby. Tapping the minimap moves the camera there.

steps.title: Advance to the Feudal Age
steps.text: Ages unlock new units and buildings. Your people have stored enough food: select the Town Center and press the age button.
steps.text_touch: Ages unlock new units and buildings. Your people have stored enough food: hold a finger on the Town Center and press the age button.

steps.title: Build a Barracks
steps.text: The age takes a while, so keep working. Select a villager, open the Military page of the build menu and place a Barracks.
steps.text_touch: The age takes a while, so keep working. Tap a villager, press Military in the build menu, press the Barracks button and lift your finger on open ground.

steps.title: Room for an army
steps.text: Every soldier takes up population too. Build a second house.
steps.text_touch: Every soldier takes up population too. Tap a villager and build a second house.

steps.title: Train soldiers
steps.text: Select the Barracks and train five militia.
steps.text_touch: Hold a finger on the Barracks to select it and train five militia.

steps.title: A new age
steps.text: Wait for the Feudal Age. The progress is shown when you select the Town Center.
steps.text_touch: Wait for the Feudal Age. Hold a finger on the Town Center to see the progress.

steps.title: Research a technology
steps.text: Technologies improve your people for good. Select the Town Center and research the Wheelbarrow. F2 opens the whole tree.
steps.text_touch: Technologies improve your people for good. Hold a finger on the Town Center and research the Wheelbarrow. The Technologies button shows the whole tree.

steps.title: New units
steps.text: The Feudal Age unlocked spearmen. Train two at the Barracks.
steps.text_touch: The Feudal Age unlocked spearmen. Hold a finger on the Barracks and train two.

steps.title: Gather your army
steps.text: Select at least five soldiers: drag a box around them, press the Army button or use Ctrl + A.
steps.text_touch: Select at least five soldiers: press the Army button, or press Area and drag over them.

steps.title: Attack
steps.text: Right click the enemy camp to attack it. If it is off screen, right click it on the minimap.
steps.text_touch: Tap the enemy camp to attack it. If it is off screen, tap the minimap to look there, then tap the camp.

steps.title: Destroy the camp
steps.text: Defeat the bandits and destroy their storehouse. Lost soldiers can be replaced at the Barracks.
